Late check-out runs until 14:00 and depends on availability. Standard check-out is 11:00.

I don't have a published fee for late check-out, so I won't quote a number. The front desk can confirm the fee and whether your date is available. If you give me your arrival and departure dates, I can set up a booking request that includes a late check-out note.

rounds.text: You can keep the room until 14:00 with a late check-out. That's three hours past the standard 11:00 check-out. It's subject to availability, so it's best to request it ahead of time. The front desk can confirm it for your date.
